class: A local gate that rewrites a CI step (appending the chosen test files to every test call) and hands the whole multi-line script to the shell as ONE command-line argument breaks once the script passes ~8 KB on Windows Git bash: the script is cut, the shell reports a syntax error, and no test runs. Wider shape: a local mirror whose command size grows with the change size works on small changes and fails on exactly the large ones that most need the tests.
mechanism: Kit 1.16.0 tools/ci_local.py narrow_pytest + add_junit on the 4-call 'Run tests on pull request' step, run as [bash, '-e', '-c', <text>] with C:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/bash.EXE. Bisected 2026-10-26: 64 chosen files = 8,176 chars parses (bash -n -c rc 0); 65 files = 8,276 chars -> rc 2 'unexpected end of file'; the raw step and a 20,000-char single-line echo both parse.

first_seen.where: row 26c worktree (build/c3-row-26c), 92 test files chosen for 6 changed files
first_seen.evidence: ci_local step 16 log: '/usr/bin/bash: -c: line 32: syntax error: unexpected end of file', 0.0 s

fix: Kit fix filed: Startup-Factory #180 (run the step from a temp file or stdin, not bash -c). Project workaround until it lands: `python tools/ci_local.py --full --pr-body <body>` (raw step, whole suite) when the default run's step 16 fails in 0.0 s with a bash syntax error.

checks: tools/ci_local.py TOTAL line: the step counts as failed and the run exits non-zero (fails closed)
detection.note: Not silent: the run is red. The gap is that the default mode cannot run tests for a change that selects more than ~64 test files on Windows.
